original_protocol.scope: Primary bath/hand2/CurrierB/rawP, original f75 excluded; shared eligible H/F source loci, readings separate. Other v72 strata not pooled or tested. Corpus already inspected; no untouched confirmation.
original_protocol.frame_exclusion: Exclude a focal ol/qokedy/qol token whenever it is the middle of exact shedy ___ shedy in that arrangement. Recompute in every shuffle; never delete tokens or concatenate gaps. Adjacent pairs of target words cannot have either member at such a frame center, since neither target is shedy. No special word positions locked.
original_protocol.statistics: Six signed contrasts: three unordered target-pair forward-minus-reverse counts, and each of three targets outgoing-to-the-other-two minus incoming-from-them. Notice qokedy outgoing pooled contrast and its two constituent edges; keep all six contrasts and both signs.
original_protocol.nulls: Primary exact_slot: shuffle readable words within page/exactordinal/linelength/unknownmask buckets. Sensitivity within_line: shuffle each readable interior span within line; endpoints and unknown barriers fixed. Preserve complete word frequencies within each declared bucket. Within-line sensitivity does not preserve every exact interior ordinal.
original_protocol.calibration: 4999 shuffles plus observed row, seeds H exact7301/within7302, F exact7303/within7304. Pooled-rank single-step minP across six contrasts and both tails, with conservative ties. Further Bonferroni x4 across H/F and both nulls. Frozen positive qokedy-direction and fully corrected p<=.05 screen; do not tune after outcomes.
original_protocol.selection_limit: Family accounts for all pairwise directions and outward/inward two-edge choices within the fixed triad, not choosing these words, this anchor set, spelling rules, strata or earlier research choices. Retrospective conditional evidence only.
original_protocol.engineering: Before manuscript scoring: hand-worked pair/excluded-center counts and shuffle bucket/unknown/endpoint invariants. 20 exchangeable and20 planted triad-direction samples per mode with199shuffles; fixed gate <=4/20null flags and>=12/20planted detections on noticed contrast triad-familyp<=.05 with positive excess. Generator-limited engineering check, not historical validation.
original_protocol.preservation: Retain every target-pair source occurrence including reverse directions and self repetitions, all six contrast outcomes, zeros, excluded-frame centers and folio contributions. Save full permutation matrices for exact numerical replay. Report finite-shuffle uncertainty if any point estimate approaches threshold; no adaptive resampling.
original_protocol.interpretation: Tests written-word order only. No semantic roles, prefix meanings, validated syntax or independence of H/F inferred. Non-significance is not absence of ordering.
